control_binding: source hashes, same launch mode and flag policy; original bridge source unchanged; instrumented private worker
single_changed_factor: Reuse successfully executed staged startup and cleanup byte-identically; add only the originally planned post-READY toy request sequence
pre_READY_operations: same original version/release/which/license-test/checkout/status/READY operations in the original order, with marker wrappers
post_READY_action: serial independent toy requests; stop after first failure/resource/deadline; immediate close after at most12
path_policy: new isolated output, source and preference paths required; do not reuse or overwrite history
prior_environment_limit: failure TEMP/TMP/PATH not paired; new paths inherently differ, so this diagnostic localizes observations rather than proving a one-factor causal effect
signal_policy: defer SIGINT/SIGBREAK through constructor and cleanup; observer KI/SystemExit and wait KI/SystemExit deferred; preserve cancellation result
cancellation_limits: OS forced kill, interpreter death, uninterruptible OS wait not guaranteed
unexpected cancellation raised inside opaque Popen before handle return cannot be retrospectively attributed; ordinary signals are deferred across this boundary
